short_description: Support for custom tool geometry, modified assortments, and private-label product development.
detail: NorthForge supports buyers who need standard products, modified specifications, or OEM tool programs built around private-label market requirements. This includes drawing review, assortment adjustment, finish selection, branding coordination, and packaging alignment.

detail: NorthForge treats packaging as part of the product offer, not an afterthought. The company supports private-label buyers with case branding, retail packaging concepts, barcode label handling, inserts, carton marks, and assortment presentation logic.

detail: For torque wrenches and related fastening tools, NorthForge emphasizes controlled verification practices and better sample-to-production consistency. This capability supports a more credible offering to industrial and automotive buyers.

detail: NorthForge frames material and hardness control as a direct answer to field failure risk, warranty exposure, and recurring-order inconsistency. The capability supports stronger buyer confidence across professional-use tool lines.
